remarks: Back on the Market - Freshly Updated and Ready for You! Available August 1st, this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom ranch offers flexible one-level living in a prime Westport location. With brand new carpeting in the bedrooms, a brand new washer and dryer, and a newly finished sunroom perfect for a home office, gym, or playroom, this rental checks every box.  Located on a private street in a quiet neighborhood, this home also offers ample off-street parking and outdoor space ideal for entertaining-just in time for summer! The versatile layout provides options for a fourth bedroom, guest suite, or work-from-home setup.  Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to Compo Beach and just minutes from downtown Westport and the train. A large attic and shed provide excellent storage, and all appliances have been updated.  Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to rent a move-in ready home in one of Westport's most desirable areas.  Available August 1st. Security deposit and credit check required.
